messages:
Ana: Heads-up — we did a KMS key rotation test on staging this morning and saw audit-ingest latency spike under high QPS. Need to discuss backup flow for key-unavailable scenarios. Anyone on call?
Matt: saw it. spike came when key fetch latency hit ~600ms and the shipper retried synchronously. We should avoid blocking the whole pipeline on KMS.
Kai: Agreed. Options: async KMS fetch with cached DEK, baked-in short-lived cache, or fallback to buffering events encrypted with previous key until KMS returns. Buffering at what granularity? per-tenant or global?
Ana: per-tenant would keep tenants isolated and lower blast radius. But memory pressure concerns.
Julia: Also customer-facing: if we delay or drop audit events we need clear telemetry to show partial coverage — customers will ask for proof. We should add an 'event_status' field: queued/encrypted/failed, and surface coverage per-tenant.
Matt: Implementation notes: change schema to include event_status (string), kms_key_id (optional), and encrypt_version. For indexing, keep a separate lightweight index entry for metadata so we don't reindex blobs.
Kai: On batching: batching encrypt->batch_upload reduces KMS calls but increases tail latency for first event. We can use an adaptive batching window: target 50-200ms or 200-500 events. Simulation shows cost drop ~40%.
Ana: Can we do prefix/KV caching for DEKs in runtime? Risk: key compromise window increases. Need to consult security policy.
Julia: Also, when we return 'queued' to customers we must include last_processed_ts and sample hash for audit validation.
Matt: For rollback/fallback plan: if KMS errors exceed threshold (5% over 5min) trigger canary fallback: switch to dedicated with old key and mark new events as 'queued'. Ops alert.
deploy-bot: deploy started: kms-key-rotation-canary v2 -> eng-sec on 2230011224
Kai: Concern: indexer cost. If we add event_status and per-event metadata we might double index size. Proposal: store full payload in blob store, index only metadata fields (tenant, ts, status, kms_key_id). Keep searchable fields minimal.
Ana: Action items: 1) Add event_status+kms_key_id to schema PR 2) implement DEK cache with TTL 3) add per-tenant buffer metrics 4) update runbook for customer comms. Volunteers?
Matt: I'll do PR #458 for schema and runbook updates.
Kai: I'll prototype DEK cache + adaptive batching. Will instrument memory pressure.
Julia: I'll draft customer-facing KB and monitoring dashboard for coverage.
Ana: Cool. Let's meet 11:30 to sync. Thanks.
